The [[Ewok/Legends|Ewok]] [[Chief/Legends|Chief]] [[Chirpa/Legends|Chirpa]] kept an '''iguana''' as [[Gender/Legends|his]] pet and [[Advisor/Legends|advisor]] on the [[Endor/Legends|Forest Moon of Endor]]. Chirpa held the [[Iguana/Legends|iguana]] in his left [[Limb/Legends|hand]] upon first meeting the [[Heroes of Yavin/Legends|Heroes of Yavin]] amidst the [[Battle of Endor/Legends|Battle of Endor]].

==Behind the scenes==
Chirpa's iguana was portrayed in [[Star Wars: Episode VI Return of the Jedi|''Star Wars'': Episode VI ''Return of the Jedi'']] by a live iguana.
